name: Fjell NightHawk ANC
description: Flagship over-ear headphones with adaptive noise cancelling tuned for open-plan offices and long-haul flights. 40 mm beryllium drivers, 45-hour battery, and a fold-flat aluminium frame wrapped in vegan leather.

images.alt: Black over-ear NightHawk headphones on an orange background
Side profile of the NightHawk ear cup and headband

name: Fjell Drift Buds
description: True wireless earbuds with a pressure-relief vent for all-day comfort. Six microphones for calls, wireless charging case, and IPX5 sweat resistance for Nordic weather.

images.alt: White Drift wireless earbuds beside their charging case

name: Nordlys Bokhylla Speaker
description: Compact bookshelf speaker with a birch-veneer cabinet and a 4-inch long-throw woofer. Pairs over Bluetooth 5.3 or 3.5 mm aux, and links with a second unit for true stereo.

images.alt: Bokhylla speaker with fabric grille on a wooden shelf

name: Nordlys Utflykt Go
description: Palm-sized outdoor speaker with a carabiner strap, IP67 dust and water sealing, and 14 hours of playtime. Built to survive a fjord hike in a jacket pocket.

images.alt: Portable Utflykt Go speaker standing on a rock outdoors

name: Rune Klippa 75

Close-up of the Klippa 75 keycap profile and volume knob

name: Rune Tunn Low-Profile TKL

images.alt: Tunn low-profile tenkeyless keyboard viewed from above

name: Rune Fullstor 108

name: Rune Delad Split Ergo
